about: Ground looks: every ground and rock material of the install's base maps a ground shape can be made in (custom geometry plan, M4a), one entry per material, each measured by tools/bake/ground_measure.py on its donor (`map`, `actor`: the best placing to copy, with a texture lightmap, at scale 1 where it has one) into the recipe tools/bake/ground.py builds from (a look given as {mesh, material, measure, recipe}; in world units, so a donor placed scaled gives the repeat its placing draws, and its copy stands at scale 1), with what a made piece lacks (`warnings`, plain words) and the twin check (`twin`: "ok", or what differs when a patch is built at the donor's size and measured again). Painted materials are made in their donor's commonest colour; translucent and masked overlays, decals, unlit materials, a third texture channel, distant scenery and materials with no texture lightmap are left out (D14; research/evidence/ground-audit.py). `maps`: the material's placings by map. `setting`: the ground audit's, by the material's name. lwrOnly: every map read is one Firaxis cooked (licensee 64; library.donors reads no other), so every donor is in a base-game package (Enemy Within, or its Slingshot content where the facts say so); the install offers no list of the files Long War Rebalance added, so no look is marked LWR-only (false for all). Written by `python -B tools/bake/ground_catalogue.py build`; the Build doesn't need it.
